steps.en: Review permission and the skill before any adoption
steps.zh: 采用前审查权限与技能正文

steps.en: If authorized, place the skill in your host and invoke it
steps.zh: 获授权后放入宿主技能目录并调用

steps.en: Requests a test-first change, then structural improvement
steps.zh: 要求先测试再修改，然后改善结构

steps.en: Supply tests and separate quality tools; retain push and deletion approval
steps.zh: 提供测试及独立质量工具，保留推送与删除审批

steps.en: Requests quality checks and an action log for the final report
steps.zh: 要求质量检查，并将操作日志纳入报告

value.en: One reference ties test-first changes to explicit checks; enforcement remains yours
value.zh: 一份参考串起测试先行与明确检查；强制执行仍由你负责
